THIS MFA IS FILED U/S.173(1) OF MV ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 31.08.2021 PASSED IN MVC NO.1749/2019 ON THE FILE OF THE XXII ADDITIONAL SMALL CAUSES AND ADDITIONAL MACT, BENGALURU, (SCCH-24),
PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION .

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT 1.

Aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 31.08.2021 passed in MVC No.1749/2019 by the Court of the XXII Additional Small Causes & Additional MACT at Bengaluru (SCCH-24) (for short 'the Tribunal'), the petitioner therein has preferred this appeal.

entities.text: XXII Additional Small Causes & Additional MACT at Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to herein as per their status before the Tribunal.

3. Brief facts of the case are as follows:
On 14.02.2019 at about 8.30 p.m. while the petitioner was traveling on Motor Cycle bearing registration No.KA.44/L-6156 met with an accident near NC:
2023:KHC:29362 Hulikere Gate, Turuvekere Taluk with a Toyota Qualis bearing Reg.No.KA-03/B-8631.
The accident was caused due to rash and negligent driving of Toyota Qualis, which was duly insured with respondent No.2-Insurance Company.

4. The Tribunal has awarded a compensation of Rs.3,91,500/- along with interest at the rate of 9%
p.a. from the date of petition till realization.
Not satisfied by the same, the petitioner has preferred this appeal.

5. After arguing the matter for some time, the advocates for the appellant and respondent No.2-Insurance Company together submitted that the compensation may be enhanced by another Rs.2,40,000/- with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till realization.

6. Given the nature of injuries sustained by the petitioner and the evidence let in before the Tribunal, I am of the opinion that the submission of advocates for the NC: 2023:KHC:29362 contesting parties are just and reasonable.

Hence, the following:
ORDER (i) The appeal is allowed in part.
